content.value:
CHARTER D202. The direction told this wave to "rule #10129's input with arithmetic". Verification proved the input is ALREADY pinned and the WINDOW is pinned by nothing.

INPUT — pinned, proven by mutation. #10129 computes rate(failed, failed + live) (deploy_ledger.ex:1222 on the PR, under the comment "THE RUNG'S NUMBER: raw terminal, denominated on settled outcomes only"). Changing the denominator to total(attempted) REDS: deploy_ledger_test.exs:1693, assert node.rate.sample == 250, got 500. The PR's own review-fix commit added that pin. Stop treating "pin the denominator" as open work.

WINDOW — pinned by nothing. router.ex:1938-1939 sets deploy_to = DateTime.utc_now(); deploy_from = DateTime.add(deploy_to, -24, :hour) — a floating "now minus", which the ledger's OWN moduledoc forbids in writing (:74-75, "every window is PINNED by an explicit inserted_at bound (never a floating now minus)") and which parse_window/2 refuses for the census route by design (:574). Mutating -24 :hour to -7 :day leaves 1,176 Elixir tests GREEN. Root cause: grep -rn 'deploy_rate' cloud/test/ returns ZERO — the router's merge_deploy_rate/2 threading and its window pinning have NO Elixir test at all. Only the Go side has fixtures, and those mock the control plane's JSON, so they cannot see the server's window choice.

CONSEQUENCE: the same input reads 42.8% (rolling 24h) or 5.1% (calendar day) — one above the 20.0 fence, one far below. The fleet's only verdict can be window-shopped, silently, by one integer.

THIRD DEFECT: the marker a human reads prints pct + sample + two companions and NEVER the window (deployMarker, cloud_status_cmd.go:442-465) — while BoxDeployRate.Window is decoded on the wire and read by NOBODY (grep -rn DeployCensusWindow internal/ finds the declaration and zero consumers).

RATIFIED so the rebase is mechanical (D202): deploys_failing at RANK 5; unmetered tone = warn (forced — main's tone-hole guard now makes tone:"" illegal, and the landed sibling silence unreported already ships attention/warn/"?"). The rebase must UNION semrole.go, never take-theirs (that deletes strained/filling/unreported and reds 11 assertions across 2 test funcs). The six conflicts are Go/JSON fixtures only — deploy_ledger.ex and router.ex auto-merge clean. A rebased patch with both suites green exists at scratchpad/pr10129-rebased-onto-main.patch from the wave-13 verifier.

THE WORK, riding #10129's rebase rather than fighting it: (1) a router-level test that REDS when the window width moves — this is a new test surface, not an edit to an existing one; (2) deployMarker renders the Window it already decodes; (3) apply the ratified rank and tone.
